full_name: Petros Koumoutsakos | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2016–2017 Engineering & Computer Science William and Flora Hewlett Foundation Fellow ETH Zurich (Switzerland)
bio: Petros Koumoutsakos, a professor of computational science at ETH Zurich, is interested in identifying computing hallmarks across disciplinary problems and advance methods for their solution. He employs these methods to understand the role of fluid flows in phenomena as varied as collective fish swimming and blood transport in cancer-induced vasculatures.
